_about: Presets picked by the two questions (format x style). Each format also picks a length (question 2, part 2, or --length): a short one of short.lengths in seconds (30, 60, 90, 120; no other values), a video one of video.lengths (standard, long, deep) or its own length in minutes inside video.targetSec (--length 7). The first entry of lengths is the default.

standard.label: About 2.5 minutes
standard.hint: one clear story, the quickest long video to make

long.label: About 5 minutes
long.hint: more detail and chapters; takes about twice as long to make

deep.label: About 10 minutes
deep.hint: deep research, many chapters; takes many hours to make

30.label: 30 seconds
30.hint: the classic Short, the quickest to make

60.label: 60 seconds
60.hint: room for one more turn in the story; about twice as long to make

90.label: 90 seconds
90.hint: a fuller story; about three times as long to make

120.label: 120 seconds
120.hint: a mini video; about four times as long to make

explainer.label: Explainer / Tutorial
explainer.renderer: remotion (diagram-style images, labels) ; manim/hyperframes when diagrams need exact shapes
explainer.imageStyle: clean flat vector illustration, simple shapes, labelled-diagram feel, soft palette

animated.label: Animated / Motion Graphics
animated.imageStyle: cinematic 2D animated film still, painterly, rich warm light, detailed background, no text
